purpose: Every us seed was checked before it was written, because a catalog asserting a verification nobody performed is what ten company_careers seeds already did once.

ats_boards.method: one public HTTPS GET per board through scripts/ats_provider.HttpAtsProvider (the production transport), content=false, one second apart
ats_boards.candidate_pool: large US-listed companies, per the request to seed from the S&P 500; index membership is not machine-checkable here and is deliberately not asserted in the catalog
ats_boards.note: A board that does not answer, or answers with no postings, is counted and not stored. Five of the fourteen were already in the catalog for ie/uk/de; the us market joined their markets list rather than creating a second seed for the same company.

local_sources.method: scripts/check_robots.py against the URL actually visited, query included, four seconds apart
local_sources.note: Dice refuses every search and allows the landing page, the same shape as Accenture: automation_allowed is false and public_read_only_page is gone, while web_search and manual_browser stay, because a person opening the page themselves is not what robots addresses.

privacy: Counts, hosts and board tokens only. No job titles, no URLs beyond the public entry points checked, no candidate data.
